subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this narrow provenance-drop repair remain a landing candidate for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76888 alongside the broader open repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759?
rationale: Both PRs target the same canonical session-state bug but encode different repair semantics, and code inspection alone cannot choose the durable product contract for stale internal handoff text.

options.title: Keep this PR pending proof
options.body: Keep this branch open while requiring real embedded-agent proof for the drop/preserve split before deciding whether to land it.

options.title: Make the broader repair canonical
options.body: If maintainers prefer the state-replay semantics in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759, treat that PR as canonical and close or supersede this branch after confirming coverage.

options.title: Accept maintainer-held proof
options.body: A maintainer with equivalent private runtime evidence may override the contributor proof gap and take ownership of the six-source predicate scope.

recommendation.title: Keep this PR pending proof
recommendation.body: Keep this branch open while requiring real embedded-agent proof for the drop/preserve split before deciding whether to land it.

likelyOwner.reason: The current helper and recent embedded-runner history make `vincentkoc` the clearest available routing candidate for this session-state repair choice.
